title: A same-PR fix after a passed fix check can reuse the record when the new head's tree equals the record head's tree
why: Lane notes-fix-large-3 (session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb): on #1706 two empty Drops-lines commits after a record with a Fix check line left a tree-identical head; merge --fix-check refuses a second fix check, so the PR needs a fresh three-round chain.
note: Filed 10:38 CST Nov 8 apart from replacement-pr-carries-review, whose lane declined it (a wider act). Fix: the refusal names the cost (a fresh chain), and a record is accepted when the new head's tree equals the newest record head's tree; it may reuse that lane's git diff --quiet proof in fix_base_problem. Owner item 426 a (2 fix checks per chain) may also cover the #1706 case. 10:42 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 10:40 CST): covered by #1957, which builds owner item 426 a (2 fix checks per chain), so #1706 takes a second fix check once #1957 lands, or a fresh chain if it cannot wait. Done when #1957 merges; reopen if a third same-tree push recurs.
